text:
harper: Morning — second day and running into onboarding blocks. Okta wants a passkey but my phone says "No authenticators available" when I try to register. Also 1Password shows "No seats available" for harper@redwood.com and I can't SSH to my assigned dev host (Connection refused). Who should I ping?

it-help: Welcome! :wave: For Okta, can you try the mobile Okta app first (Settings > Security > Add security method). For the phone error, what OS/version? Also share the exact SSH error `ssh user@host` prints.

harper: iPhone 15, iOS 17.1. SSH shows `ssh: connect to host 10.24.5.12 port 22: Connection refused`. 1Password invite email might've gone to my personal account — I used harper.personal@gmail earlier.

people-ops: If you accepted with a personal email we can transfer the seat. Filing PEOPLE-5199. Please confirm which email you want: harper@redwood.com?

harper: Yes please resend to harper@redwood.com.

it-help: For SSH connection refused, that means the host is reachable but the SSH daemon isn't accepting. Try `nc -vz 10.24.5.12 22` and `ssh -vvv user@10.24.5.12` and paste the brief output. If it's blocked by firewall we'll check the bastion/proxy.

harper: `nc -vz` returns `Connection to 10.24.5.12 22 port [tcp/ssh] succeeded!` but `ssh -vvv` shows `debug1: connect to address 10.24.5.12 port 22: Connection refused`. Weird.

dev-oncall: That usually indicates an intermediate proxy closing the session. Are you coming over corp VPN? Also check `ssh -p 2222 bastion` flow — many dev hosts are only reachable via the bastion. Try `ssh -J user@bastion user@10.24.5.12`.

harper: Ah I wasn't on VPN. Connected to VPN and `ssh -J user@bastion user@10.24.5.12` now prompts for password but my key isn't working: `Permission denied (publickey,password).`

it-help: Generate a keypair and paste the public key here or run `gh ssh-proxy` if you used the infra quickstart. Commands: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "harper@redwood.com"` then `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. We'll add it to your account.

harper: Generated and pasted pubkey.

dev-oncall: Added public key to your dev account. Try again.

harper: Auth success! Thanks. 1Password seat: people-ops says they resent and I accepted harper@redwood.com invite, working now.

people-ops: PEOPLE-5199 closed; seat transferred and invite accepted.

harper: Okta passkey: I enrolled via the Okta iOS app and it worked as a platform passkey. All set. Thanks everyone :tada:

it-bot: Ticket IT-3010 created for follow-up: "verify bastion routing rules + document VPN prerequisite for dev host access" (assigned it-help).
